## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass.
- [ ] A visible change follows `docs/DESIGN.md`, and the pull request shows the gallery screenshots of the changed scenes (`--gallery=<scene> --screenshot=<file>`).
- [ ] Every new or changed text has English and Turkish strings.
- [ ] It works for every game. Nothing exists for one title; what is known per title is data.
- [ ] No game data anywhere: no dumps, keys, firmware, saves, or logs and screenshots that show game memory or game art.
